severity.summary: Forinthry areas list is sparse and polluted with activities. Four strings only, three of which are activity/access labels rather than geography. Wiki documents dozens of named surface places, dungeons, and hubs for a region that covers nearly all of north-eastern Gielinor. Content duplicates the four area labels and only adds two elite dungeons + two bosses. Upgrades balloon to 112 rows including many cross-region mis-homed rows — separate bookkeeping issue from areas, but naming collisions (Abyss / Daemonheim / Agility) need disambiguation when areas, content, and upgrades share the same string.

current_areas.name: Wilderness Slayer
current_areas.reason: Wiki page Wilderness Slayer describes Mandrith assignments / contracts / XP systems, not a geographic site. Comparable bad pattern to anachronia areas 'dinosaurs/hunting/farming'. Should live under content (and optionally upgrades for diary/sword perks).

current_areas.name: Daemonheim
current_areas.reason: Wiki: huge dungeon complex under castle on icy peninsula in eastern Wilderness; Fremennik camp, Dungeoneering entrance, dig site, peninsula mines, Shadow Reef dock. Not in Wilderness danger zone while on the peninsula/camp. Hard league dependency for Dungeoneering.
current_areas.naming_collision: Same string used as area, content, and upgrade 'Daemonheim / Dungeoneering' — disambiguate roles

current_areas.name: Wilderness Agility Course
current_areas.reason: Wiki lists it under Notable locations (level 50+, NW deep Wilderness). It is a fixed map facility, so place-like. Still skill-training-coded; if areas should prefer settlements/landmarks, keep it but do not treat as the only deep-wild marker.
current_areas.also_upgrade_note: User flag: also appears as upgrade-ish training value; catalog trainingMethodIds includes agility:wilderness-course. Prefer content kind Agility + upgrade for Wilderness sword lap XP / diary, not a second areas clone.

current_areas.name: Abyss entrance
current_areas.reason: Not a named settlement. Wiki: Mage of Zamorak at level 5 Wilderness near the southern runite mine teleports players into the Abyss. 'Abyss entrance' is an activity access label. Better area name: 'Mage of Zamorak (Abyss access)' or rely on low-Wilderness geography and put Abyss RC in content only.
current_areas.naming_collision: Area 'Abyss entrance' vs content 'Abyss entrance' vs upgrade 'Abyss access' — three near-duplicate strings

sparsity.assessment: Forinthry/Wilderness is one of the largest surface regions in the game; 4 areas (2 of them non-places) under-represents geography vs peer elective regions.

proposed_areas.principle: Areas = named geographic places / facilities players navigate to. Activities, masters, and access systems go in content. Upgrades = permanent unlocks / gear / diaries / reward-shop items. Prefer density similar to Asgarnia (8–14 place chips), not activity soup.
